answer: Watch when identities go quiet together. Each agent answers small liveness pings at random times, and the ledger records its gaps: when it drops out, for how long, and when it comes back at dawn. Independent operators fail at unrelated times. A farm on one server or one API account goes hollow all at once whenever that shared backend hiccups, and its names come back in the same second. Identities whose outage patterns overlap far beyond chance share one reward. Faking separate outages means really running separate machines, like keeping each fake's pigment on its own canvas.
